disclamer.title: Disclaimer
disclamer.description: User health and personal data are stored securely and are used only for generating personalized diet recommendations in this prototype system.
disclamer.description2: This system is a prototype and does not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

whySection.title: Why this diet plan ?
whySection.description: This diet plan is personalized based on the user's body parameters, lifestyle, and fitness goal. It helps users achieve healthy weight changes safely while maintaining balanced nutrition and energy levels.

Methodology.title: AI Methodology:
Methodology.point1: Collects user inputs (gender, weight, height, age, activity, goal, target weight)
Methodology.point2: Converts inputs into numerical format using encoding
Methodology.point3: Uses a trained Random Forest model to predict calories and macros
Methodology.point4: Estimates timeline based on weight difference
Methodology.point5: Generates meal-wise nutrition distribution (breakfast, lunch, dinner)
